comparison.objective: Close a valve-lockout clamshell and insert its retaining bar; candidate commissions a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Hold sprung halves closed while aligning and sliding a bar through two holes versus hex-key insertion, collar tuning, counterholding, and setscrew locking.
comparison.success_condition: Valve remains shut and clamshell/bar stay aligned, still, and released versus two acceptable dynamic stops and post-lock witness-torque retention.
comparison.reason: Insertion and locking are generic shared primitives; this record does not test adjustment or iterative impact response.
